newsitem.title: MEXICO: Telmex obtains $1 bln syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Telmex obtains $1 bln syndicated loan.

text.p: Mexican telephone company Telefonos de Mexico SA (Telmex) said on Friday it had obtained a $1 billion syndicated loan at a maturity of one year and at a rate of LIBOR plus 0.60 percent.
Telmex, Mexico's largest private firm, said the loan was negotiated with Chase Manhattan Bank and Morgan Guarantee Trust Co as lead managers for a group of 30 banks.
Telmex said investor demand for the loan was higher than expected, confirming the "confidence that Telmex has among international credit institutions."
It added the loan would mature on May 13, 1998.
